correctness.rationale: For the actual 13-vertex PG(2,3) no-collinear-triple complex, reconstructed 13 points, 13 four-point lines, 52 excluded triangles, face vector (13,78,234,234) and absence of 5-caps. Independently computed top boundary ranks mod 2,3,5,101 = 168,165,168,168; inspected the attached exact SymPy Smith program establishing (1^165,3^3,0^66). Every missing triangle cones outside its line, so K is simply connected; Hurewicz and Smith basis changes of three-cell degrees yield 3 Moore M(Z/3,2) plus 66 S^3. Exact integral SNF was inspected in source, not independently rerun; modular checks alone would not exclude higher 3-power torsion.
